components.name: Stack
components.description: Lays its children out in a column or a row.

components.name: Card
components.description: A bordered block with an optional title.

components.name: Section
components.signature: Section(title: text, children: [Component], open?: true|false, collapsible?: true|false)
components.description: A titled part of the answer, collapsible when it is long.

components.name: Callout
components.signature: Callout(tone: neutral|info|success|warning|danger, title: text, body?: text)
components.description: A highlighted note: info, success, warning or danger.

components.name: Table
components.signature: Table(columns: [Col], rows: [[text|number|Badge|FileRef|Link]], caption?: text, sortable?: true|false)
components.description: Rows and columns. A cell is a text, a number, a Badge, a FileRef or a Link.

components.name: Col
components.signature: Col(label: text, kind?: text|number|percent|money|date, align?: left|right|center)
components.description: A column of Table: its label and how its values are formatted.

components.name: Metric
components.signature: Metric(label: text, value: text|number, delta?: text|number, trend?: up|down|flat, note?: text)
components.description: One figure with its label and its change.

components.name: Step
components.signature: Step(title: text, body?: text, status?: todo|doing|done|blocked)

components.name: FileRef
components.signature: FileRef(path: text, label?: text, page?: number, line?: number)
components.description: A file or a place in a file; a click opens it in the app.

components.name: Link
components.description: A link to a web page.

examples:
root = Stack([title, kpis, table, note])
title = Heading("Terminal agents compared", 2)
kpis = MetricRow([m1, m2])
m1 = Metric("Tools compared", 5)
m2 = Metric("With a native sandbox", 3, "+1", "up")
table = Table([Col("Tool"), Col("Sandbox"), Col("Memory")], rows)
rows = [["Claude Code", Badge("yes", "success"), "CLAUDE.md"], ["Aider", Badge("no", "danger"), "chat history"]]
note = Callout("warning", "Not documented", "OpenCode does not document its internal database schema.")

root = Steps([s1, s2, s3])
s1 = Step("Install the runtime", "Run the installer, then restart the terminal.", "done")
s2 = Step("Add a provider key", "Open Settings, then Providers.", "doing")
s3 = Step("Send a first message")

root = Card([summary, plan], "Migration status", "info")
summary = MetricRow([Metric("Tables moved", 14, "+3", "up", "this week"), Metric("Left", 6)])
plan = Section("Next", [Steps([Step("Move the audit tables", null, "doing"), Step("Switch the reads", null, "todo")])])
